settings.principal_message: Welcome to Shawan School and College Paharpur. Our mission is to democratize world-class scientific, intellectual, and moral instruction for the sons and daughters of Paharpur and Dera Ismail Khan. We foster an academic environment where disciplined study, modern laboratories, dedicated mentors, and Islamic ethical values empower each student to realize their highest academic and career aspirations.
settings.about_text: Shawan School and College is a forward-looking educational institution situated on Rangpur Road in Paharpur, Dera Ismail Khan, Pakistan. With comprehensive educational offerings spanning early childhood foundation, primary, middle schooling, and higher secondary college tiers (Pre-Medical, Pre-Engineering, Computer Science), the institution bridges contemporary technological pedagogy with proven academic discipline. Guided by certified subject specialists and equipped with advanced laboratories, we prepare youth for competitive university admissions and purposeful citizenship.
settings.mission: To cultivate intellectually competent, morally upright, and socially proactive leaders through rigorous academic training, innovative STEM education, and values-based character development.
settings.vision: To stand as the leading center of academic excellence in the Dera Ismail Khan division, nurturing students who excel in provincial board examinations, national higher education, and constructive nation-building.

academic_levels.description: Activity-based foundational literacy, numeracy, phonics, general science, and Islamic character nurturing.
Analytical math, physical sciences, Urdu, English communication, and computer fundamentals.

Collegiate level instruction oriented towards MDCAT, ECAT, university admissions, and professional disciplines.
